caption: The drawing features an array of stylized floral motifs arranged on a plain, off-white background. There are four large, vertically-oriented floral patterns placed centrally and towards the upper section of the composition, each with elaborate multi-petaled flowers, curved stems, and variously shaped leaves. The flowers and leaves are composed in palettes of red, pink, magenta, yellow, gold, green, teal, and pale blue, with the stems intertwining or curling. Smaller floral arrangements and individual leaves are scattered among the larger forms, similarly colored. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a horizontal border made up of continuous, connected floral and foliate shapes, which include scalloped flower heads and curling leaves in dark green, teal, maroon, yellow, light pink, and red. The lower left side also has a vertical band of similar decorative flowers and leaves, echoing the same colors and styles seen in the main motifs. The entire drawing is symmetrical and balanced in the arrangement, and all elements are rendered in flat, solid colors without shading.
title: Embroidery from Bedspread
